reviews.title: Ugh!! TOO MANY ADS!!
reviews.text:
This could have been one of the best trivia games in the entire App Store. Unfortunately the STRESSFUL & TIME-CONSUMING ADS made it unbearable! The game was relaxing but the ads were frustrating—too many and they took too long to get through them.

And I call B**S** to your excuses to others that ads allow the game to be free! A sprinkling of ads are acceptable, but the bombardment of them that take up double the time of a single 10-question game is ridiculous!! There are many more games out there to choose from. Adios!

Deleted the app!! 👎🏼
